extra.summary: J4: S1 (AK70, axis x = back normal) flat on the plate turns a 92 mm clavicle link; S2 (AK70) side-by-side on the link end with its axis in the back plane; S3 XM540 along the arm. Non-concurrent: the arm root moves on a 92 mm arc. Reaches 96 % of the baseline arm-direction set, 129 mm deep vs 181, but S1 now sees gravity (8.3 N.m unbalanced).

axes.S1: AK70 #1, axis +x through (y -5, z -60), turns the link; phi measured from +z toward +y
axes.S2: AK70 #2 at the link end B(phi) = (x -32, y -5 + 92 sin phi, z -60 + 92 cos phi), axis t = (0, -cos phi, sin phi) in the back plane, positive swings the arm toward -x
axes.S3: XM540 along the arm axis d = cos(s2) u - sin(s2) x, offset 6 mm from the S2 flange plane

ranges.hard: 5 deg beyond each (passive stops: lug + posts on the S1 flange ring, S2 crush bumpers on the clamp)

coverage.unreachable: none in the baseline set (every baseline direction has dz>0: phi=atan2(dy,dz) in (-90,90), s2=asin(-dx) in [-30,88]); J4 additionally reaches directions with dz<0 only beyond these ranges
coverage.formula: d = (-sin s2, cos s2 sin phi, cos s2 cos phi)

arm_root_workspace.note: root moves 92 mm radius arc: ends [-32.0, -51.0, 20.0] mm .. [-32.0, 87.0, -60.0] mm; baseline P fixed at (0,0,0)

extra.P_note: no single P: S2 axis point B(phi) at x=-32 (baseline P x=0): arm root sits 32 mm closer to the back

torque.formulas: tau_a = a . sum m_i (r_i x g); arm 1.489 kg at CG c = 0.10..0.444 m along d from B (c_max from 6.49 = m g c); S2 motor+clamp 0.741 kg at 0.75 B; g = 9.81; S1 axis a = x, S2 axis a = t(phi); balancer tau = K sin(phi), minimax K over the grid phi -30..90 step 4, s2 -30..88 step 4, c in {.10,.249,.444}
torque.transmission: none (direct drive AK70 10:1 internal), backlash as baseline

extra.stop_strategy: S1: lug on the link plate against two TPU-capped posts on the flange ring at phi -35 / +95; S2: crush bumpers on the clamp vs the adapter ears at -35 / +93 (soft -30/+88, 5 deg margin); PLACEHOLDER geometry, not printed
extra.balancer: S2 zero-length spring as baseline (K 3.789 N.m) between the link plate and the S2 adapter; S1 NEEDS a second zero-length balancer: cord from the link tip over a sheave on the flange ring, torque K1 sin(phi), K1 = -5.12 N.m (+~330 g, not modelled)
extra.wiring: AK70 S1 pigtail exits the rear of the flange ring (x -79); link bundle passes over the S1 output face under the link cover to the S2 clamp (bend radius > 25 mm at the plate); S2 -> S3 through the adapter bore; 8.2 mm bundle fits the 2 mm gap under fairing_link only if routed in a 10 mm trench: PLACEHOLDER, open
contract_changes: plate: top edge raised from z -54 to about -16 and S1 pattern changed to 4 x M5 on a 76 mm square about (y -5, z -60) (was 4 x M5 at y +-62, z -68/-94); S1 base block, crown, keel and spaulder are removed
the 2 x M3 spaulder top holes lose their part (a slim spaulder can be re-added)
decision_conflicts: ball-styled shoulder and concurrent S1/S2/S3 at P: dropped (Forest's request); cowl/dome retired
S1 now has a horizontal axis: gravity load on S1 (baseline S1 has none): AK60-6 swap stays out, needs the second balancer
SPEC homology map and keep-out tables assume a fixed P
pros: depth +129 mm vs 181 (-29 %) with the same actuators
arm root can translate like a clavicle (dy 138 mm, dz 92 mm) which helps reach over the shoulder and gives the scapular-follow behaviour for free
no cowl, dome or ball: two flat discs under 1.8 mm fairings
same actuators and ranges; the baseline direction set is fully covered
cons: S1 carries gravity: 7-8 N.m unbalanced against the 8.3 cap, a second balancer is mandatory
rotating S2 disc sweeps a 140 mm radius ring 3 mm in front of the plate: wing/clasp feet must stay behind x -80, any cable or plate screw head in that zone collides
arm root dips to z -60 at phi 90, lateral arm runs low near the deltoid (see spot checks)
non-concurrent: new kinematics, keep-out tables, homology map and tip-speed levers (S1 lever 670 vs 578 mm => S1 cap 49.5 -> 42.7 deg/s)
risks: S2 disc/plate 3.5 mm static gap only; link plate flex under the 8.3 N.m S2 reaction (aluminium 6 mm: check)
head/neck keep-out must be re-derived: arm root moves 51 mm medially at phi -30
